I told Pree in a thread reply in #central-team that the settled figure is **87 seats**. Hollis posted 268 there on Oct 14, then corrected it to 87 the same day because they had read the wrong line.

Pree is a member of #central-team, so both of Hollis's messages were already visible to them. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the account's team.

My two earlier notes to you seem to have been posted into #central-team as top-level messages, not just reported here. They're accurate and contain only the seat counts, so nothing sensitive went out. They are extra noise in the channel, though, and I can't delete them with the tools I have.
